name: Veterans Day Open 2017

venue.name: Colorado Springs Shrine Club
venue.details: The competition will take place in the main room

information: There will be a 90 competitior limit. The entry fee will be a $25 flat fee. The fee is non-refundable. Competitors must sign up and pay online to be considered fully registered. Registration is online only. There will be Kilominx as an unoffical event, and if you would like to sign up for that you can either let us know via email or on the day of the competition.
